help:
Usage: touch [-c] [-a|-m] [-d STRING|-r FILE|-t STAMP] FILE...
{{help:help:0}}
{{help:version:0}}
Existing files are unsupported, including with -c. This command creates missing files only; it cannot update timestamps.
Note: -a/-m/-d/-r/-t are recognized but unavailable without a portable timestamp setter.
Rejection aliases --access-time (-a), --modification-time (-m) and --stamp (-t)
request unavailable timestamp-setting capabilities and fail before mutation.
Ordinary option/operand errors exit 1; documented capability refusals retain their own status.

options.name: no-create
options.description: Skip missing files without creating them.

options.name: access-time
options.description: Recognized but rejected before mutation: Select only the access timestamp.

options.name: modification-time
options.description: Recognized but rejected before mutation: Select only the modification timestamp.

options.name: date
options.description: Recognized but rejected before mutation: Use the supplied date and time.

options.name: reference
options.description: Recognized but rejected before mutation: Use timestamps from the reference file.

options.name: stamp
options.description: Recognized but rejected before mutation: Set timestamps using the numeric time form.

options.name: time
options.description: Recognized but rejected before mutation: Select the timestamp to change.
